added_failures_note: Derived by delta from the reviewed run's own suite records: baseline_suite (48c4c9d104edfa2cdd8d9b08d0883e3da02d00fe) failure_ids are [test_real_entry_geometry_round_trips, test_real_sectioned_set_reduction_is_within_one_percent]; after_suite (5d52a37bc4eb2900a18f23476517a75e82c8ce6a) failure_ids are the two positive-definite cases listed above, so the added set is those two. Both head failures sit at tests/test_vs3_jacket_positive_linkage.py and the manifest attributes them to scaffolding (the rebuilt entries are not installed in the read-only cache); the 6 mm one is independently a real measure failure.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The stored linkage.npy holds a negative eigenvalue or lost the finite-source coil block; deleting the refusal or reverting the splice makes it fail.

load_sectioned_machine returns a machine for a matrix with a negative eigenvalue; it fails if the JointLinkageNotPositiveDefinite raise is removed, but its scratch matrix is synthesised by flipping the smallest eigenvalue when no retired entry is present, so the fixture is not the pre-repair entry its name claims.

The installed repaired entry's passive block holds any negative eigenvalue; on this host the arm fails at np.load with FileNotFoundError because the entry is not installed, so it does not yet assert the measure.

VSU's or VSL's reduced bare inductance leaves the 3 per cent band around COAXIAL_REFERENCE_H; the source manifest records the series reduction at 12.88x and 17.30x that reference, so this assertion would fail were the entry installed.

findings.text: blocking: The evidence document the Done-when names is absent at head, so none of the three done-when clauses has a recorded receipt; git ls-tree 5d52a37bc4eb2900a18f23476517a75e82c8ce6a of the fragments directory lists no vs3-linkage-repair.html.

blocking: The 6 mm entry built by the re-keyed build stores a joint linkage with 40 negative eigenvalues (minimum -4.009411e-08 H, all in the passive block), so done-when clause (1)'s positive-definite requirement is unmet for the 6 mm set and the loader refuses the entry this node delivers.

blocking: VSU's and VSL's reduced bare inductance does not match the dense coaxial reference within the stated 3 per cent under either reduction the stored geometry admits (5.63e-4 and 7.56e-4 H against 4.37e-5 H, or 2.20e-6 and 2.95e-6 H), so done-when clause (1)'s tolerance is unmet and the coupling gap it was to close is unresolved.

blocking: test_vertical_coil_bare_inductance_matches_the_coaxial_reference asserts VSU/VSL within 3 per cent of COAXIAL_REFERENCE_H, which the source manifest's own measurement contradicts; it skips on this host only because the entry is uninstalled, so the suite reports 7 skipped rather than the failure the measure implies.

follow-on: Six of the twelve entry-reading assertions skip on this host because the rebuilt entries were never installed into /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.cache, so the head gate reports 5 passed 7 skipped in this file and the central positive-definiteness measure is not exercised by any arm that ran.

follow-on: This file, tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py and tests/test_unseen_source_full_plant.py are changed but are outside the brief's declared write paths, which required the node to stop and name any such file; only validate.py is named in the manifest's follow_ons.

follow-on: _sector_vertices and _annulus_ports re-implement the annulus-sector geometry that nova/circuit/conductor.py:119 annulus_sector_vertices and :153 annulus_sector_columns now own, so the fixture can drift from the builder it is meant to test.

follow-on: The clipped label is fixed by editing the two text-group translate x values directly in the SVG; no figure generator or save-with-check source changed in the diff, so the mandated re-render through the check path left no recorded run even though the rendered PNG reads clean.

follow-on: The literal negative control declared two negative eigenvalues with the square representation restored; the arm reports 56 negatives over 128 coil arms (minimum -5.706e-07 H) because its Schur complement is not reduced to the fourteen coil channels, so control_holds is false and the declared count was not reproduced.

follow-on: The coupled-plant head arm was cut short at the deadline (11 passed, 1 skipped) and reached no summary line, so after_suite.completed is false and that file is the one gate file reporting nothing either way.
